title: Crisp German Skillet with Ackee
description: A twist on a classic German dish, this skillet recipe features ackee, a Caribbean favorite. The crisp texture and zesty flavors come together for a unique and delicious meal.
instructions: 1. Cook the sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, about 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
2. In the same skillet, add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the ackee to the skillet and stir to combine with the onion and sausage.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and zesty mustard.
5. Pour the egg mixture over the ackee mixture in the skillet.
6. Sprinkle the crumbled bacon over the top of the egg mixture.
7. Cook until the eggs are set, about 3-4 minutes.
8. Serve the skillet hot, topped with toasted German bread.
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
